messages.content: Choose broad chapter refresh units from STORY. Do not assign beat counts. Do not invent plot. Return valid JSON only.

STORY:
A researcher begins a normal shift cataloging samples. An alarm interrupts the routine. The researcher secures the samples and begins a long repeated diagnostic process that occupies most of the story. After that process, one final diagnostic resolves the incident. The researcher shuts down the lab and reunites with a waiting colleague.

A chapter is a LARGE refresh unit. Use the fewest natural broad chapters. Keep continuous setup and the main repeated process together when possible. A short final chapter is appropriate when STORY enters its explicit terminal resolution.

Return exactly:
{"chapters":[{"chapter":1,"outline":"..."}]}
